Build a complete set across distinct referents; do not collapse a multi-answer question to a familiar winner. Preserve existing concise valid strings. Add missing direct relation answers and remove only demonstrably irrelevant or contextually contradicted claims. A source positively assigning a second artist, birth date for a different person, or second sport is evidence to retain it. Check each proposed deletion once more against all originals before producing the final short list.
